stem: A high-value clone has been maintained through many tissue-culture passages and still looks normal. What is the strongest QA conclusion?
choices: Appearance is useful but passage history and periodic fidelity checks should still be retained
Normal appearance proves no genetic or epigenetic change is possible
All regeneration routes have identical variation risk
rationale: Long-term culture can involve genetic or epigenetic change, so fidelity management should include history and verification beyond appearance alone.
